n: Wi-Fi® Network I/O Extender with 4 IR Ports (CEN-IO-IR-204)
d: CEN-IO-IR-204 Wi-Fi® Network I/O Extender with 4 IR Ports

specs.label: Transceiver
specs.value: IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n Wi-Fi (2.4 or 5 GHz 2-way RF), static IP or dynamic IP via DHCP

specs.label: Security
specs.value: 64 and 128-bit WEP, WPA and WPA2-PSK with TKIP and AES

specs.label: Wireless Communication range
specs.value: Up to 50 feet (15 m), subject to site-specific conditions

specs.label: Gateway
specs.value: Requires an 802.11a/b/g/n wireless access point and Ethernet-enabled Crestron control system

specs.label: IR/Serial
specs.value: Supports 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.2 MHz or Serial TTL/RS-232 (0–5 V) up to 115.2k baud

specs.label: Power Pack (included)
specs.value: Input: 100–240 VAC, 50/60 Hz; Output: 1.2 A @ 5 VDC; Model: PW-0510WUL

specs.label: Mounting
